newsitem.title: JAPAN: VW sees rising Audi sales in Japan in '97.
newsitem.headline: VW sees rising Audi sales in Japan in '97.

text.p: Volkswagen Group Japan KK (VW Japan), the Japanese unit of Volkswagen AG, hopes to sell 15,000 Audis in Japan in 1997, up from an estimated 11,000-12,000 this year, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Sales in the January-September period rose 21.6 percent from the same period in 1995 to 7,365 vehicles, according to industry data.
VW Japan also launched two 1997 models in Japan on Thursday.
It introduced the 1997 version of its Audi A8 3.7 and Audi A6 Avant 2.6 models.
The price will remain unchanged from last year, ranging between 3.495 million yen and 9.5 million yen.

VW Japan is scheduled to increase the number of its sales outlets to 100 by the end of December from 94 as of end-October, she said. DUO, the Japanese dealer of Toyota Motor Corp, which also sells VW and Audi cars, will increase the number of its outlets to 135 by end-December from 115.
